editorial_thesis: Fresh signal is moving agent maturity from isolated model quality toward population-level governance, contestable evidence, and explicit enterprise defaults.

topic_groups.title: Governed Agent Rollouts
topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub's new default-feature policy creates a near-term governance deadline, while two fresh research papers show why component-by-component compliance is insufficient for multi-agent systems.

sources.title: Default Enablement of Copilot Features
sources.why_selected: It turns agent governance into an explicit enterprise policy decision with a dated enforcement window.
sources.usefulness: Use the unconfigured-feature model as a template for Buildn capability defaults and exception registers.

sources.title: ARIA governance architecture for multi-agent finance
sources.why_selected: It names the failure mode where locally compliant agents create collectively unacceptable outcomes.
sources.usefulness: Borrow population-level observed-versus-expected monitoring for client agent portfolios.

sources.title: Multi-Agent AI Architecture for Regulated Insurers
sources.why_selected: It translates regulated enterprise roles, orchestration, MCP, A2A, and human access controls into one reference architecture.
sources.usefulness: Use the role-to-authority mapping when scoping regulated client workflows.

topic_groups.title: Contestable Agent Evidence
topic_groups.selection_rationale: New work on multimedia verification and clinical training points to a practical design rule: memory, feedback, and evaluation should preserve the path from evidence to decision.

sources.title: Self-Evolving Multimedia Verification through Memory Consolidation
sources.why_selected: SEMV treats provenance-bearing arguments as the bridge between evidence, human contestation, revision, and memory.
sources.usefulness: Prototype verification-gated memory and scoped repair in Buildn research artifacts.

sources.title: Scaffolding-Oriented Multi-Agent System for Clinical Interview Training
sources.why_selected: A randomized study shows specialized agents can improve process quality without inflating diagnostic accuracy.
sources.usefulness: Separate coaching, simulation, and evaluation roles in client enablement workflows.

sources.title: Copying explains collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
sources.why_selected: It shows local visibility and recency can create collective conventions without explicit coordination.
sources.usefulness: Treat shared scratchpads and recent artifacts as active control surfaces, not neutral storage.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Physical Systems
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The freshest multi-agent systems research offers a useful counterweight to software-only coverage: physical autonomy still depends on simple local guarantees, topology awareness, and explicit safety margins.

sources.title: Connectivity Preservation and Graph Stretching in Range-Only Swarm Dispersion
sources.why_selected: It derives a local movement rule that preserves every existing visibility edge using only range measurements.
sources.usefulness: Use the visibility-margin idea as a metaphor and test design for bounded delegated execution.

sources.title: Agent-Based Modeling of Systems of Systems
sources.why_selected: It frames complex systems as interacting agent-based components rather than a single centralized controller.
sources.usefulness: Map Buildn workflows as system-of-systems with local contracts and emergent failure review.
